name: railway_redeploy
description: REDEPLOY a service's current build in an environment (serviceInstanceRedeploy) — re-runs the latest deployment, e.g. to pick up new variables or recover from a crash. Requires `serviceId` and `environmentId` (both from railway_get_project). Returns a boolean. This restarts live infrastructure and causes a brief redeploy — confirm the exact service and environment first. (To roll back to a specific older build instead, find its deployment id with railway_list_deployments; this pack redeploys the current one only.)

body_defaults.query: mutation serviceInstanceRedeploy($serviceId: String!, $environmentId: String!) { serviceInstanceRedeploy(serviceId: $serviceId, environmentId: $environmentId) }
